purpose: raw float monocular depth for plants.jpeg

source_image.exif: stripped — no intrinsics available (see roadmap Known gaps)

output_semantics.convention: z-distance along the optical axis, NOT ray length
output_semantics.evidence: depth_anything_3.utils.geometry.pixel_space_to_camera_space does K^-1 @ [u, v, 1] * depth, i.e. the ray is normalised to z=1 before scaling, which is the pinhole z-depth convention. Pixel centres are integer indices 0..W-1 (torch.meshgrid over arange), no +0.5 offset.

preprocessing.note: longest side resized to process_res, then each side rounded to the nearest multiple of the ViT patch size 14; ImageNet normalisation

camera.source: this preset has no cam_dec — no intrinsics are predicted, and none were supplied
camera.extrinsics_c2w_or_w2c: w2c (3x4), identity-ish for a single view

caveats: No EXIF, no calibration, no fiducial. Absolute scale is unresolved.
Any intrinsics above are the MODEL's estimate, not a measurement. Using them makes the reconstruction self-consistent with the depth, not correct.
Depth is emitted at the model's internal resolution, not 3000x4000. Upsampling it does not create detail.
